before.lua_content:
-- Source: timorous/Lheao.pl
-- Monk Epic 1.0: Lheao gives the Celestial Fists book.
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- items: 12970, 1682, 1683

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Emote("jumps at your voice and begins laughing at his skittishness.")
		e.self:Say("Ahh, hello there. Not many people know of this place, so visitors are quite rare.")
	elseif e.message:findi("i have found the book of immortals") or (e.message:findi("found") and e.message:findi("immortals")) then
		e.self:Emote("looks up at you, eyes wide in astonishment.")
		e.self:Say("My god, you found Immortals?! I need an individual to watch over this book and make sure it is protected. Would you be willing to take this responsibility?")
	elseif e.message:findi("responsibility") then
		e.self:Say("I'm sorry, " .. e.other:GetName() .. ", but I could only give this book to a true master, such as a member of the Whistling Fists Order. Unless you can give me proof that you are one, in addition to Danl's reference, there is no way I'll let you take charge of the Celestial Fists.")
	elseif e.message:findi("celestial fists") then
		e.self:Say("The Celestial Fists is the title of a book written by an unknown author. Its rarity commands top dollar in the scholarly community but the secrets revealed in the book are what truly makes it dangerous.")
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12970, item2 = 1682}) then
		e.self:Say("Astonishing! I believe you are indeed worthy to be given the responsibility of watching over this book. Take great care that it does not fall into the wrong hands.")
		e.other:SummonItem(1683) -- Celestial Fists book
		e.other:Ding()
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

before.name: #Kaiaren
before.lua_content:
-- IdleQuest epic 1.0 steps have no minimum level; preserve class and item checks.
-- Source: trakanon/#Kaiaren.pl
-- Monk Epic 1.0: true Kaiaren converts the book and performs final turn-in.
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Check eligibility before the consuming hand-in matcher; reject without item loss.
-- items: 1683, 1684, 1688, 1689, 10652

function event_spawn(e)
	eq.set_timer("depop", 3600000)
end

function event_say(e)
	if e.other:HasItem(1689) then
		if e.message:findi("lheao") then
			e.self:Say("Hmmm, never heard of him. Well, it doesn't matter, the book is here now. I suppose you'd like to find the Fists and have a nice chat with them, eh?")
		elseif e.message:findi("have a nice chat with them") then
			e.self:Say("No, you will need to get their attention. Fortunately, I know how you can do this.")
		elseif e.message:findi("how can i do this") then
			e.self:Say("If you use his true name, Eejag, in your formal challenge, he will respond.")
		end
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1683}) then
		e.self:Say("Now, then. Where did you find this, monk? This is not just some light reading to be borrowed from the town library. Who gave this to you?")
		e.other:SummonItem(1689) -- Book of Celestial Fists
	elseif e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1684}) then
		e.self:Say("Ahhh, impressive indeed! Take this scale and show it to the Fist of Air wherever he may be. Good luck.")
		e.other:SummonItem(1684)
	elseif e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1688, item2 = 1689}) then
		e.self:Say("I honestly did not believe you could have defeated Vorash. I will sew these fangs into magical fist wraps and they shall be yours.")
		e.other:SummonItem(10652) -- Celestial Fists epic
		eq.set_global("MnkEpic1", "1", 5, "Y1")
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

function event_timer(e)
	if e.timer == "depop" then
		eq.depop()
	end
end

		elseif e.message:findi("how can i do this") or e.message:findi("how you can do this") then
			e.self:Say("My guess is that the weakest of the Fists will be the easiest to draw out. He is egotistical and arrogant. How he came to master the Discipline of Fire, I do not know. He will most likely be in another form, one of his element. When you find the one you believe to be the Fist, you must challenge him. If you use his true name, Eejag, in your formal challenge, he will respond. A flame can burn intensely but it cannot last for long. Know this when you battle him.")
		end
	end
end

	if e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1683}) then

		e.other:SummonItem(1689) -- Book of Celestial Fists
	elseif e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1684}) then
		e.self:Say("Ahhh, impressive indeed! Take this scale and show it to the Fist of Air wherever he may be. Good luck.")
		e.other:SummonItem(1684)
	elseif e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1688, item2 = 1689}) then
		e.self:Emote("bows his head and breathes a long sigh as if relieved of a great weight. He then looks up at you.")
		e.self:Say("I honestly did not believe you could have defeated Vorash. Even though he sought nothing but war and bloodshed, it is a life nonetheless and we must mourn him. I will sew these fangs into magical fist wraps and they shall be yours. Remember Xenevorash. A purpose can be found for every situation and individual. To achieve perfection is to perceive this truth.")
		e.other:SummonItem(10652) -- Celestial Fists epic
		eq.set_global("MnkEpic1", "1", 5, "Y1")
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- IdleQuest epic 1.0 steps have no minimum level; preserve class and item checks.
-- Source: trakanon/Kaiaren.pl
-- Monk Epic 1.0: mad Kaiaren returns Celestial Fists and spawns true Kaiaren.
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Check eligibility before the consuming hand-in matcher; reject without item loss.
-- items: 1683, 1684

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Say("AHHH get it away from me go away .. leave me alone")
	elseif e.message:findi("celestial fists") then
		e.self:Say("Eh? What's that? Bah! That was destroyed long ago. Don't waste my time with fairy taAAAAAGGHHH GET IT AWAY!!!!")
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1683}) then
		e.self:Emote("eyes open wide and he attacks you!")
		e.other:SummonItem(1683) -- Celestial Fists book
		eq.attack(e.other:GetName())
		eq.spawn2(95183, 0, 0, 2470, 306, -339, 0) -- true Kaiaren
	elseif e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1684}) then
		e.self:Say("Ahhh, impressive indeed! Take this scale and show it to the Fist of Air wherever he may be. Good luck.")
		e.other:SummonItem(1684)
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

function event_death_complete(e)
	e.self:Say("Not bad.. Now lets see if you can find my trueform if you do we discuss this further.")
end

-- items: 1687

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Emote("ignores you.")
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if e.other:Class() == "Monk" and item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 1687}) then
		local x = e.self:GetX()
		local y = e.self:GetY()
		local z = e.self:GetZ()

		eq.depop()

		eq.spawn2(85223, 0, 0, x, y, z, h) -- Deep
	else
		e.self:Say("I have no use for this, $name.")
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
